questions: Is the goal to maximize the sum of values, or simply to compute the sum for any arbitrary choice that satisfies the condition (e.g., the sum of all balls)?
If maximizing, are we allowed to choose any subset (any number of balls) as long as #black >= #white, or must we choose exactly some number?
If maximizing, can we choose zero balls? (That satisfies #black >= #white trivially, sum = 0.)
Are the balls distinct? Can we choose the same ball multiple times?
If maximizing, should we consider only subsets where #black == #white, or any with #black >= #white?
Do we need to output the maximum sum, or just any sum? If any, which one?
Are there any constraints on the total number of balls chosen? (e.g., must choose at least one ball?)
If maximizing, can we choose balls in any order, or is the order fixed? (Irrelevant for sum.)
